convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.209 (miss 19.7719 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.813 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ml_result.model_name: ORION ESA event final log10-risk estimator
ml_result.training_dataset: ESA Collision Avoidance Challenge training dataset

feature_schema.exponentiated_event_risk_display: 10 ** predicted_log_risk on the ESA event-risk scale; not a calibrated probability or Foster Pc

evidence: Miss distance 19.7719 km against configured screening threshold 25 km (fraction 0.790875).

TCA, relative speed, object type, physical Pc, and ML output do not change this category; ML and Pc are reported separately.
review_priority.explanation: LOW ORION review priority under orion-geometry-review-v1: miss distance is 79.087% of the configured screening threshold; TCA is 2026-10-25T02:19:13.215925+00:00. This is geometry-only triage, not a collision probability or operational risk label.

ai_risk_assessment.target_definition: Normalized screening-priority index in [0,1]; not collision probability, Pc, or ESA log10 event risk.

feature_provenance.source: screening_pipeline PhysicsResult; propagated SGP4 TLE encounter geometry

limitations: Queue index is not a collision probability, Foster Pc, or calibrated event-risk probability.
Relative speed reference is a normalization scale, not an empirically validated threshold.
ESA log10-risk regressor is withheld because historical and live feature semantics are unverified.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.209 (miss 19.7719 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.813 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.target_definition: Normalized screening-priority index in [0,1]; not collision probability, Pc, or ESA log10 event risk.

feature_provenance.source: screening_pipeline PhysicsResult; propagated SGP4 TLE encounter geometry

limitations: Queue index is not a collision probability, Foster Pc, or calibrated event-risk probability.
Relative speed reference is a normalization scale, not an empirically validated threshold.
ESA log10-risk regressor is withheld because historical and live feature semantics are unverified.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.209 (miss 19.7719 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.813 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: MEDIUM under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: MEDIUM under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: MEDIUM under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.753 (miss 6.17518 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.815 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: HIGH under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.815 (miss 4.63118 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.816 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: HIGH under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

feature_schema.exponentiated_event_risk_display: 10 ** predicted_log_risk on the ESA event-risk scale; not a calibrated probability or Foster Pc

ai_risk_assessment.target_definition: Normalized screening-priority index in [0,1]; not collision probability, Pc, or ESA log10 event risk.

feature_provenance.source: screening_pipeline PhysicsResult; propagated SGP4 TLE encounter geometry

limitations: Queue index is not a collision probability, Foster Pc, or calibrated event-risk probability.
Relative speed reference is a normalization scale, not an empirically validated threshold.
ESA log10-risk regressor is withheld because historical and live feature semantics are unverified.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.815 (miss 4.63118 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.816 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: HIGH under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

evidence: Miss distance 4.63118 km against configured screening threshold 25 km (fraction 0.185247).

review_priority.explanation: HIGH ORION review priority under orion-geometry-review-v1: miss distance is 18.525% of the configured screening threshold; TCA is 2026-10-25T04:38:40.186341+00:00. This is geometry-only triage, not a collision probability or operational risk label.

ai_risk_assessment.target_definition: Normalized screening-priority index in [0,1]; not collision probability, Pc, or ESA log10 event risk.

feature_provenance.source: screening_pipeline PhysicsResult; propagated SGP4 TLE encounter geometry

limitations: Queue index is not a collision probability, Foster Pc, or calibrated event-risk probability.
Relative speed reference is a normalization scale, not an empirically validated threshold.
ESA log10-risk regressor is withheld because historical and live feature semantics are unverified.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.815 (miss 4.63118 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.816 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.270 (miss 18.2376 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.931 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: MEDIUM under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.575 (miss 10.6338 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.818 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: MEDIUM under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

ai_risk_assessment.target_definition: Normalized screening-priority index in [0,1]; not collision probability, Pc, or ESA log10 event risk.

feature_provenance.source: screening_pipeline PhysicsResult; propagated SGP4 TLE encounter geometry

limitations: Queue index is not a collision probability, Foster Pc, or calibrated event-risk probability.
Relative speed reference is a normalization scale, not an empirically validated threshold.
ESA log10-risk regressor is withheld because historical and live feature semantics are unverified.

ai_risk_assessment.explanation: Normalized geometry/speed queue index: proximity 0.575 (miss 10.6338 km / 25 km screen), relative-speed component 0.818 (reference 15 km/s); deterministic fallback, not Pc or trained ESA prediction.
ai_risk_assessment.ranking_explanation: Final priority combines 50% deterministic AI queue index, 30% normalized geometry, and 20% relative Pc percentile only in a multi-event result where every event has the same Pc provenance (no numerical, event-bound Pc was available); otherwise AI and geometry weights are renormalized and Pc rankings remain separate. An ESA-prior Pc retains its unvalidated research-prior status and is not treated as operationally calibrated.

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.

assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.

convergence.method: 16-interval bounded subdivision with per-basin golden-section refinement of Euclidean relative distance
convergence.bracket_origin: coarse sampled local minimum and adjacent sample epochs

collision_probability.encounter_plane_definition: e_v = normalized relative velocity; e_1 is the normalized TCA miss vector projected perpendicular to e_v (or a deterministic least-aligned Cartesian axis at zero miss); e_2 = cross(e_v, e_1); project the common-frame relative position covariance onto [e_1, e_2].
assumptions: TCA relative-position uncertainty is represented by a bivariate Gaussian.
Relative motion is locally linear over the encounter interval.
Relative position covariance is treated as constant over the encounter interval.
No covariance-independence assumption was authorized; cross-object correlation remains unknown.
warnings: Applicability assumptions are not independently verified by TLE-only propagation.
This is a research implementation and is not NASA operational conjunction software.

risk_assessment.classification_basis: Low from research_pc under orion-physics-pc-risk-v2; this physics class controls the displayed final class.
limitations: Thresholds are ORION project policy, not universal safety standards.
Risk score and class are derived from physics Pc only; AI and geometry priority remain separate.

automatic_research_pc_assessment.method_name: ORION TLE-age baseline Foster 2D research estimate
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)
automatic_research_pc_assessment.covariance_method: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day) assigned in RTN at TCA and rotated to TEME; no covariance propagation is performed.
automatic_research_pc_assessment.hbr_method: ESA target/chaser span population prior by ORION object class; assumed span diameter converted to a per-object radius and combined; not an authenticated object dimension.

provenance.covariance_policy_name: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

covariance_policy_options.esa_population_prior: ESA Kelvins population-prior covariance (TLE-derived state; unvalidated mapping)
covariance_policy_options.tle_age_baseline: TLE-age position-sigma baseline (0.1/0.5/0.2 km plus 0.1/1.5/0.2 km/day)

provenance.log_domain_fallback: same Foster circular Gaussian integral, used only when probability-domain Foster quadrature fails

automatic_research_pc_assessment.ranking_basis: LOW under orion-geometry-review-v1; geometry-only queue rank, separate from Pc
automatic_research_pc_assessment.sensitivity_reason: Range is the min/max of coupled ESA p10, p50 and p90 prior scenarios; it is not a statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: This is a prior-based research estimate, not an event-specific or operationally validated Pc.
The selected TLE-age covariance is a configured uncertainty model, not measured object-specific covariance.
ESA r/t/n sigma labels are mapped to local RTN at TCA, then rotated to TEME using each propagated SGP4 state; this frame interpretation is an explicit model assumption.
Covariance is diagonal in RTN; ESA correlations and cross-object covariance are unavailable and omitted.
The covariance is assigned at TCA; no covariance propagation from TLE epoch is performed.
ESA target/chaser roles are mapped from ORION object class: active/payload to target; debris/rocket body/unknown to chaser.
ESA span inputs are treated as diameters and converted to radius; this is an assumed size mapping, not authenticated object dimensions.
Object covariances are assumed independent for the Foster relative covariance.
p10/p50/p90 HBR scenarios vary the ESA span prior; the resulting sensitivity endpoints are not confidence bounds.
Scenario covariance multiplier: 1; scenario HBR multiplier: 1. Both are explicit research-scenario controls, not measured inputs.
When a result is below binary64's representable range, the same Foster disk integral is evaluated in log space and reported in scientific notation rather than substituted with zero.
